not_checkable_from_records: minimality of plant_m (internal(m-1) is not recorded)
the label sets themselves (only C and D are recorded), hence exact C, D values; only consistency bounds are checked
the base points P_i and therefore any Q = O or duplicate skip for r >= 2
seeded determinism of a record (requires the producer's generator and seed streams; maximum_runs 0)

checks.description: record parses as one JSON object per line and carries exactly the toy_jobs_jsonl schema fields
block == 'main' in the main census file
cell id is one of the 45 grid cells and bits, r, n equal the values in b<bits>-r<r>-n<n>
c is an integer in [0, n_curves(cell)) of the re-derived design
one record per (cell, block, c): no duplicate key
census completeness: every planned (cell, c < n_curves) key is present
p is prime and p.bit_length() == bits
N prime (prime order), Hasse |p + 1 - N| <= 2 sqrt(p), N != p, a != 0, b != 0, 4a^3 + 27b^2 != 0 mod p, 0 <= a, b < p
N = #E(F_p) confirmed: N * P == O for a deterministic point P != O (per distinct curve)
cells at the same bits share the curve of index c (same p, a, b_coef, N)
status in {ok, failed_infrastructure, degenerate}; failed_infrastructure carries a reason
ok record: null_C and null_D are lists of 20 ints; gap_C, gap_D, plant_m, plant_internal, plant_C, plant_D ints; plant_feasible bool
gap_meta T is the least T with ((2T+1)^r - 1)/2 >= ceil(1.02 n) + 8 (every record)
ok record: enumerated - duplicate_skips - infinity_skips == n; enumerated <= |H(r,T)|; last is the enumerated-th vector of H(r,T); first is at position <= 1 + infinity_skips
degenerate record: enumerated == |H(r,T)| (whole half-box), last == final vector of H(r,T), and the collected labels fall short of n
r = 1 records: duplicate_skips == 0 and infinity_skips == 0 (cP = +-c'P forces c = c' when 2T < N)
count consistency of every ok set (gap, 20 nulls, plant): n-1 <= D <= min(p, n(n-1)/2), D(2C+P) >= P^2 (Cauchy-Schwarz, P = n(n-1)/2), 2C <= (floor(n/2) - 1) P
plant: 4 <= plant_m <= n/2, plant_C >= plant_internal (superset monotonicity)
plant_feasible agrees with the rule: feasible iff plant_internal >= 0.30 x mean(null_C) (exact); infeasible records carry plant_m == n/2
seconds is a non-negative number
degenerate / failed records carry no counts (gap, null, plant fields null)
replication jobs file: records (if any) have block 'replication' and a flagged cell; count reported
